Steel Quirk.name: Steel Quirk
Steel Quirk.description:
🔩 You turn your whole body into moving steel.

🌱 At the start you hold steel form for a short exchange, resist punches, blades and handgun fire, and dent thin metal within arm's reach.
📈 With training: forced entries, protected carries, sustained fighting, endurance under extreme temperatures.
⚠️ You need dietary iron and air; impacts wear your steel down, extreme heat and poison gas still threaten you, and iron-rich food does not refill you instantly.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Finite Fuel, as low iron and sustained use weaken your steel.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu's Steel. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.
🎒 Starts with: Quirk fuel pack x5, Fuel belt

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Stamina +10, Quirk Output +10, Blocking +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Metallic Brace, Metal Knuckle Jab
🛡️ Resists: bludgeoning, slashing, piercing
Steel Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: steel body; still moves, speaks. Start: a short exchange resisting ordinary punches, blades, handgun fire, denting thin metal; repeated hits shorten it. Long fights, temperature extremes need training.
Limits: iron fuels it; iron fatigue weakens long use; iron-rich food aids recovery, not instantly. Must breathe: smoke, gas, low oxygen endanger. Overloads injure. Training adds duration, tolerance, not endless hardness. Outside heat heats it; no fire, metal control, weapon shapes.
Quirk Strain: light: guard, jab; moderate: clinch, entry, carry, obstacle crossing; heavy: repeated blows, long protection; severe: signature assault, heat endurance, long transformation.
Drawback: built in, the canon Finite Fuel.
Canon: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Transformation.
Law: steel blows, forced entries need a license or self-defense; user owns the damage.
Look: steel body.
